apps.name: Firefox (Native Deb PPA)
apps.description: Mozilla Firefox installed natively from Mozilla Team PPA (eliminating Snap sandbox delays on Ubuntu/Kubuntu).

native_deb.command:
add-apt-repository -y ppa:mozillateam/ppa && echo 'Package: *
Pin: release o=LP-PPA-mozillateam
Pin-Priority: 1001' > /etc/apt/preferences.d/mozilla-firefox && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --target-release 'o=LP-PPA-mozillateam' firefox

native_deb.command: install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings && curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg && chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg && echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu $(lsb_release -cs 2>/dev/null || echo jammy) stable" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list && apt-get update && apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin && usermod -aG docker ${SUDO_USER:-$USER}
